title: listCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for List COMP instances, covering table, row, column, cell, displayed, focus, selection, drag/drop members, list scrolling/focus/reset methods, callbacks, and inherited PanelCOMP / COMP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when scripting List COMP table styling, cell state, selection overlays, rollover/radio/focus rows and columns, or drag/drop positions.
List attribute priority is table level first, then row and column, then cell; displayAttribs exposes the final displayed cell attributes after that priority is resolved.
Use scroll(row, col) to move the List COMP viewport to a target cell.
Use setKeyboardFocus(row, col, selectAll=True) only for editable field cells when a script needs keyboard focus or full text selection.

Use reset() when the List COMP should rerun its initialize callbacks, matching the Reset parameter callback path; callbacks such as onInitCell, onSelect, onEdit, and onDropGetAccept belong in the List COMP callback DAT.
